Backend /api/events/{record_id} returns listing_picture and graphic separately as expected.

rca_of_the_issue: Previous symptoms were caused by UI rendering/mapping: duration meta was still shown, Airtable raw HTML was not parsed, markdown list/paragraph classes were not being applied, and hero precedence/display used the wrong image behavior. Current preview no longer reproduces those symptoms. Browser console only showed third-party analytics/cdn-cgi aborts and navigation-aborted requests from the test harness, not functional page errors.
